assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The patient has the right to file an appeal within ninety days of the notice.
The Explanation of Benefits is attached for detailed cost breakdowns.
